document.title: Disable dynamic speculative decoding when DP is enabled
document.body:
## Summary

Disable `num_speculative_tokens_per_batch_size` when data parallelism is enabled.

Dynamic speculative decoding currently picks K from each scheduler's local scheduled request count. With DP, ranks can choose different K values, and the EAGLE/draft proposer has K-dependent DP collectives. This change warns and falls back to the static `num_speculative_tokens` value when `data_parallel_size > 1`.

Some codex-generated breadcrumbs to follow:
<details>
  Rank-local proposer entry / skip

  - _input_fits_in_drafter() depends on local common_attn_metadata.max_seq_len:
    https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/2a47a9ff0f4f302ee64915dfea64642757e31ee4/vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py#L4407-L4420

  - sample_tokens() computes that predicate locally:
    https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/2a47a9ff0f4f302ee64915dfea64642757e31ee4/vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py#L4497-L4503

  - If true, rank enters propose_draft_token_ids(); if false, it does not:
    https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/2a47a9ff0f4f302ee64915dfea64642757e31ee4/vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py#L4520-L4523

  - False path zeroes draft tokens instead of proposing:
    https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/2a47a9ff0f4f302ee64915dfea64642757e31ee4/vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py#L4561-L4568

  Rank-local / dynamic draft count

  - Scheduler picks num_spec_tokens_to_schedule from local len(num_scheduled_tokens) under dynamic SD:
    https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/2a47a9ff0f4f302ee64915dfea64642757e31ee4/vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py#L1050-L1055

  - Worker reads that local K from scheduler_output:
    https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/2a47a9ff0f4f302ee64915dfea64642757e31ee4/vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py#L4863-L4868

  - Worker passes K into EAGLE/MTP drafter:
    https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/2a47a9ff0f4f302ee64915dfea64642757e31ee4/vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py#L5110-L5120

  K controls number of drafter forwards

  - First drafter forward always happens before K == 0 check:
    https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/2a47a9ff0f4f302ee64915dfea64642757e31ee4/vllm/v1/spec_decode/llm_base_proposer.py#L501-L524

  - K == 0 returns after that one forward:
    https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/2a47a9ff0f4f302ee64915dfea64642757e31ee4/vllm/v1/spec_decode/llm_base_proposer.py#L538-L547

  - K == 1 or parallel drafting returns after one forward:
    https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/2a47a9ff0f4f302ee64915dfea64642757e31ee4/vllm/v1/spec_decode/llm_base_proposer.py#L549-L558

  - K > 1 runs K - 1 additional drafter iterations:
    https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/2a47a9ff0f4f302ee64915dfea64642757e31ee4/vllm/v1/spec_decode/llm_base_proposer.py#L587-L613

  - Each additional iteration runs the drafter model again:
    https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/2a47a9ff0f4f302ee64915dfea64642757e31ee4/vllm/v1/spec_decode/llm_base_proposer.py#L650-L668
</details>
